entries.source: Allakhazam quest 1802 Breaking the Blade (Mid): 'Go talk to Alb and Hib Mystemas ... entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, 'Slay Centurion Favius in Salisbury Plains.', 'Slay Centurion Favius in Cornwall.'), SourceText = replace(SourceText, 'Slay Centurion Favius in Salisbury Plains.', 'Slay Centurion Favius in Cornwall.') WHERE ID BETWEEN 21284 AND 21286
entries.why: the text sent the player to Salisbury Plains but Favius spawns in Cornwall (54009,50332); patch 1.75 is what moved him to the Fallen Tower in Salisbury, so Cornwall is the 1.65 spot and the text was wrong
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 176 Animare il morti: 'Per Patch 1.75: Centurion Favius can now be found next to the Fallen Tower in Salisbury Plains'; Related Zones: Cornwall, Salisbury Plains
